content.text:
Model the vintage robbie the banker coin bank toy using this reference: https://tinyurl.com/35h4sb3u

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.
I'll build it from my own recollection of the toy's look, since I can't fetch the reference link here.

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT'); bpy.ops.object.delete()
def mat(n,c,r=0.4,m=0):
    x=bpy.data.materials.new(n); x.use_nodes=True; b=x.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=c; b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=r; b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=m; return x
M=dict(suit=mat('Suit',(0.05,0.08,0.2,1),0.5),skin=mat('Skin',(0.9,0.62,0.5,1),0.5),white=mat('White',(0.95,0.95,0.92,1),0.5),
 red=mat('Red',(0.7,0.05,0.05,1),0.4),gold=mat('Gold',(0.9,0.65,0.15,1),0.25,1),black=mat('Black',(0.02,0.02,0.02,1),0.3),
 base=mat('Base',(0.25,0.12,0.06,1),0.6),grey=mat('Grey',(0.75,0.75,0.78,1),0.3,0.8))
def fin(o,m,smooth=True):
    o.data.materials.append(M[m])
    if smooth: bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
    return o
def sph(n,loc,sc,m):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=48,ring_count=24,location=loc); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=sc; o.name=n; return fin(o,m)
def cyl(n,loc,r,d,m,rot=(0,0,0),sc=(1,1,1),v=48):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=v,radius=r,depth=d,location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=sc; o.name=n; return fin(o,m)
def box(n,loc,s,m,rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc,rotation=rot); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=s; o.name=n; return fin(o,m,False)
# base (pedestal)
cyl('Base',(0,0,0.15),1.3,0.3,'base',sc=(1,0.8,1))
cyl('BaseTrim',(0,0,0.33),1.15,0.08,'gold',sc=(1,0.8,1))
# legs & shoes
for s in(-1,1):
    cyl('Leg',(s*0.4,0,0.75),0.22,0.8,'suit')
    sph('Shoe',(s*0.4,-0.15,0.42),(0.3,0.5,0.2),'black')
# body (vest + jacket)
sph('Torso',(0,0,1.75),(0.95,0.75,1.1),'suit')
sph('Shirt',(0,-0.5,1.9),(0.35,0.4,0.75),'white')
sph('Vest',(0,-0.55,1.45),(0.5,0.35,0.5),'red')
for i in range(3): sph('Button',(0,-0.88,1.25+i*0.18),(0.05,0.03,0.05),'gold')
# coin slot on back top / on hat
# head
sph('Head',(0,0,3.15),(0.62,0.6,0.7),'skin')
sph('Nose',(0,-0.6,3.1),(0.13,0.15,0.13),'skin')
for s in(-1,1):
    sph('EyeW',(s*0.25,-0.5,3.3),(0.12,0.07,0.14),'white')
    sph('Pupil',(s*0.25,-0.56,3.3),(0.05,0.03,0.07),'black')
    sph('Ear',(s*0.62,0,3.15),(0.1,0.15,0.2),'skin')
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=(s*0.25,-0.54,3.5),rotation=(0,s*0.15,0)); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=(0.15,0.03,0.025); fin(o,'black',False)
# moustache
for s in(-1,1): sph('Mustache',(s*0.17,-0.62,2.93),(0.2,0.08,0.07),'black')
# smile
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(location=(0,-0.52,2.85),rotation=(math.radians(90),0,0),major_radius=0.17,minor_radius=0.02); o=bpy.context.object; o.scale=(1,1,0.5); fin(o,'red')
# bow tie
for s in(-1,1): sph('Bow',(s*0.17,-0.55,2.6),(0.17,0.08,0.12),'red')
sph('BowKnot',(0,-0.57,2.6),(0.07,0.07,0.08),'red')
# top hat with coin slot
cyl('HatBrim',(0,0,3.75),0.85,0.08,'black')
cyl('HatTop',(0,0,4.25),0.55,0.95,'black')
cyl('HatBand',(0,0,3.88),0.57,0.2,'red')
box('CoinSlot',(0,0,4.74),(0.38,0.03,0.015),'gold')
box('Slotdark',(0,0,4.745),(0.33,0.015,0.016),'grey')
# arms
sph('ArmL',(-1.0,0,1.9),(0.22,0.25,0.7),'suit'); 
o=bpy.context.object; o.rotation_euler=(0,math.radians(-15),0)
sph('HandL',(-1.12,0,1.2),(0.18,0.18,0.18),'white')
# right arm outstretched holding coin tray
sph('ArmR',(1.2,-0.4,2.1),(0.22,0.25,0.7),'suit'); o=bpy.context.object; o.rotation_euler=(math.radians(-60),math.radians(25),0)
sph('HandR',(1.45,-0.9,1.8),(0.18,0.18,0.18),'white')
cyl('Tray',(1.45,-0.9,1.97),0.4,0.04,'gold')
cyl('Coin',(1.45,-0.9,2.02),0.17,0.03,'gold')
# coins stack on base
for i in range(5): cyl('Coin',(-0.9,-0.7,0.4+i*0.04),0.2,0.035,'gold')
# lights / camera / world
w=bpy.context.scene.world or bpy.data.worlds.new('W'); bpy.context.scene.world=w; w.use_nodes=True
w.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[0].default_value=(0.55,0.62,0.7,1)
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=(4,-5,6)); l=bpy.context.object; l.data.energy=900; l.data.size=5
l.rotation_euler=(math.radians(50),0,math.radians(40))
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA',location=(-5,-3,3)); l=bpy.context.object; l.data.energy=300; l.data.size=4; l.rotation_euler=(math.radians(70),0,math.radians(-60))
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=30,location=(0,0,0)); fin(bpy.context.object,'white',False)
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(5.5,-9,3.6)); c=bpy.context.object
c.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,2.4))-c.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler(); bpy.context.scene.camera=c
c.data.lens=50
s=bpy.context.scene; s.render.engine='BLENDER_EEVEE'; s.render.resolution_x=900; s.render.resolution_y=1000
import os; os.makedirs('output',exist_ok=True)
s.render.filepath=os.path.abspath('output/robbie.png'); bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
# export without floor
bpy.data.objects['Plane'].select_set(False)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in s.objects:
    if o.type=='MESH' and o.name!='Plane': o.select_set(True)
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=os.path.abspath('output/robbie.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True)
result=os.listdir('output')

I built a cartoon banker coin-bank figure and exported it. I couldn't open the reference link, so the design comes from my own memory of Robbie the Banker, not from your reference. Check it against the reference before relying on it.

I rendered it once and looked at the image, and the figure reads clearly. I didn't iterate on it after that first render.

The figure is a stout banker in a navy suit with a red vest, gold buttons and a red bow tie. It has a moustache and a black top hat with a red band. The top of the hat has a gold coin slot, and the figure stands on a round brown-and-gold base. Its right hand holds a gold coin tray, and a small stack of coins sits on the base. Everything is made from primitive shapes with simple colored materials.

The `.glb` contains the figure only, without the floor plane.

Files are in `./output/`:
- `robbie.glb`
- `robbie.png`
